sources.title: mlvlab/DAVI | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Purpose and Scope DAVI (Diffusion Prior-Based Amortized Variational Inference) is a PyTorch-based system for solving noisy inverse problems in image restoration. The system enables efficient posterior sampling with a single neural network evaluation and provides generalization to both seen and unseen measurements without requiring test-time optimization.

Abstract Recent studies on inverse problems have proposed posterior samplers that leverage the pre-trained diffusion models as powerful priors. These attempts have paved the way for using diffusion models in a wide range of inverse problems.
